title: iWant Original “Love at First Spike” earns nomination at International Emmy Awards 2026
summary: The 2025 iWant youth-oriented original series “Love at First Spike” bags a nomination at the International Emmy Awards as the sole entry representing the Philippines in this year’s ceremony.
